title: Grade 3 ARAL English Vocabulary
source: Official Grade 3 ARAL English Curriculum, Rosario West & East Districts, SY 2026-2027

words.definition: A small, furry animal often kept as a pet.
words.example_sentence: The cat is sitting quietly on the soft mat near the door.
words.story_context: Mia has a small cat named Mimi. The cat sits on a mat near the door.
words.sentence_blank: The ____ is sitting quietly on the soft mat near the door.

words.definition: A piece of fabric placed on the floor to sit or step on.
words.example_sentence: The little cat likes to sleep on the clean mat every afternoon.
words.story_context: After playing, the cat sits on a mat near the door.
words.sentence_blank: The little cat likes to sleep on the clean ____ every afternoon.

words.definition: Something you wear on your head for shade or protection.
words.example_sentence: Ben wears his red hat when he goes outside to play.
words.story_context: Ben has a new red hat. He wears his hat when he goes outside.
words.sentence_blank: Ben wears his red ____ when he goes outside to play.

words.definition: A small furry animal with a long tail.
words.example_sentence: A small rat runs quickly near the box beside the kitchen.
words.story_context: A small rat lives near an old box. It runs quickly toward the food.
words.sentence_blank: A small ____ runs quickly near the box beside the kitchen.

words.definition: A flying animal that is active at night.
words.example_sentence: The bat flies around the trees when the sky becomes dark.
words.story_context: At night, the bat flies around the garden looking for food.
words.sentence_blank: The ____ flies around the trees when the sky becomes dark.

words.definition: A friendly animal that you care for at home.
words.example_sentence: I have a little pet that I feed and care for every day.
words.story_context: Ana has a little pet at home. She gives her pet food and clean water.
words.sentence_blank: I have a little ____ that I feed and care for every day.

words.definition: Feeling joyful, glad, or pleased.
words.example_sentence: The boy is happy because he received a new book from his mother.
words.story_context: Leo feels happy because he loves reading books.
words.sentence_blank: The boy is ____ because he received a new book from his mother.

words.definition: The bright star that gives light and warmth to the earth.
words.example_sentence: The bright sun shines in the sky while the children play outside.
words.story_context: The sun comes up early in the morning and shines in the sky.
words.sentence_blank: The bright ____ shines in the sky while the children play outside.

words.definition: To rest your body on a chair or on the floor.
words.example_sentence: Please sit on your chair and listen carefully to your teacher.
words.story_context: Her teacher asks her to sit on a chair in the reading corner.
words.sentence_blank: Please ____ on your chair and listen carefully to your teacher.

words.definition: To put or place something down carefully.
words.example_sentence: I set my book on the table before I start reading.
words.story_context: He sets the book carefully on the table before reading.
words.sentence_blank: I ____ my book on the table before I start reading.

words.definition: Turned on or giving off light.
words.example_sentence: The lamp is lit at night so that I can read my book.
words.story_context: The lamp is now lit, so the room becomes bright.
words.sentence_blank: The lamp is ____ at night so that I can read my book.

words.definition: Small in size.
words.example_sentence: I see a little bird sitting quietly on a branch near our house.
words.story_context: A little bird sits on a branch near the house and sings.
words.sentence_blank: I see a ____ bird sitting quietly on a branch near our house.

words.definition: The highest part or surface of something.
words.example_sentence: The toy is on top of the box beside the bookshelf.
words.story_context: He puts the toy on top of a box while cleaning.
words.sentence_blank: The toy is on ____ of the box beside the bookshelf.

words.definition: A drawing that shows places, roads, and directions.
words.example_sentence: I look at the map carefully to find the way to the park.
words.story_context: His father brings a map to help them find the way to the park.
words.sentence_blank: I look at the ____ carefully to find the way to the park.

words.definition: An adult male person.
words.example_sentence: The kind man walks to the store to buy some food for his family.
words.story_context: The kind man helps carry some of the books for the child.
words.sentence_blank: The kind ____ walks to the store to buy some food for his family.

words.definition: A friendly four-legged pet that barks.
words.example_sentence: The friendly dog runs around the yard and plays with the children.
words.story_context: Dan has a friendly dog named Max. Max runs around the yard.
words.sentence_blank: The friendly ____ runs around the yard and plays with the children.

words.definition: A cozy shelter or resting house for an animal.
words.example_sentence: The dog sleeps inside its small den when it wants to rest.
words.story_context: The dog has a small den under a tree that keeps it safe.
words.sentence_blank: The dog sleeps inside its small ____ when it wants to rest.

words.definition: To break up and move dirt or soil with paws or hands.
words.example_sentence: The dog likes to dig in the soil under the big tree.
words.story_context: It starts to dig with its paws in the soil under the tree.
words.sentence_blank: The dog likes to ____ in the soil under the big tree.

words.definition: An oval object laid by a female bird with a shell.
words.example_sentence: The hen has an egg in her nest near the farmer's house.
words.story_context: A hen sits quietly in her nest. Beside her is a small egg.
words.sentence_blank: The hen has an ____ in her nest near the farmer's house.

words.definition: A raised area of land smaller than a mountain.
words.example_sentence: We walk slowly up the hill while enjoying the trees and flowers.
words.story_context: Sara and her brother walk slowly up a small hill to see the view.
words.sentence_blank: We walk slowly up the ____ while enjoying the trees and flowers.

story.text: Mia has a small cat named Mimi. The cat likes to play with a ball every morning. After playing, the cat sits on a mat near the door. Mia gives her cat some food and water. Mia is happy to have a playful cat.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Mia's cat?
questions.explanation: The story states that Mia has a small cat named Mimi.

questions.prompt: What does Mimi like to play with?
questions.explanation: Mimi likes to play with a ball every morning.

questions.prompt: When does Mimi play?
questions.explanation: The story says Mimi plays every morning.

questions.prompt: Where does Mimi sit after playing?
choices: On a mat near the door
questions.answer: On a mat near the door
questions.explanation: After playing, the cat sits on a mat near the door.

questions.prompt: Why is Mia happy?
questions.explanation: Mia is happy to have a playful cat.

stories.title: The Mat
stories.text: Tom has a clean mat in front of his house. His little cat likes to sit on the mat every afternoon. Tom cleans the mat when it gets dirty. He wants his house to look neat and clean. His cat enjoys resting on the mat.

questions.explanation: Tom has a clean mat in front of his house.

questions.prompt: Where is the mat?
questions.explanation: The mat is placed in front of the house.

questions.prompt: When does the cat sit on the mat?
questions.explanation: The little cat likes to sit on the mat every afternoon.

questions.prompt: What does Tom do when the mat gets dirty?
choices: He hides it in a box
He gives it to a dog
questions.explanation: Tom cleans the mat when it gets dirty.

questions.prompt: Why does Tom clean the mat?
choices: He wants the house neat and clean
To sell it at the store
questions.answer: He wants the house neat and clean
